verdict.rationale: A state business-registry service could plausibly publish an official MCP server, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The keyless Socrata open-data JSON API on data.colorado.gov is a developer building block hosted on a separate platform, not an official MCP server, so it earns no credit.
